title: The Repair Café on Willow Street
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答8个问题。所有题目和选项均为英文。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。先读题，再读文章。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。
passage:
Last month, the residents of Willow Street started a Repair Café in the community hall. People bring broken things, and volunteers help them fix these items. The idea is simple: if we repair things, we produce less waste.

A: Mei brings her old lamp. "The switch is broken," she says. "If you show me how to fix it, I will try at home." Tom, a volunteer, shows her the steps. "Because the switch is loose, the light does not work," he explains. "Therefore, we must tighten it." Mei fixes the lamp in ten minutes. She is very happy.

B: Sam brings a torn jacket. "I cannot sew," he says. "If I learn, I will repair my clothes next time." A volunteer named Lisa teaches him. "You should use a strong needle," she says. "You could also watch a video first." Sam sews the jacket and wears it home.

C: The café also has a table for small electronics. Mr. Chen brings a radio. "It makes a strange noise," he says. "If the noise continues, I will buy a new one." A volunteer opens the radio. "The problem is dust," she says. "You must clean it often. Then it will work well." Mr. Chen cleans the radio, and the noise stops.

At the end of the day, the volunteers count the items. They repaired twelve things. "If we do this every month, we will reduce our waste," says Mei. "We should tell our neighbours." The next Repair Café is on the first Saturday of next month.

questions.prompt: Where did the residents start the Repair Café?
questions.explanation: 原文第一段第一句明确说在社区大厅（community hall）开始。
questions.evidence: Last month, the residents of Willow Street started a Repair Café in the community hall.

questions.prompt: What does Mei bring to the Repair Café?
questions.explanation: 第二段A部分第一句说Mei带来她的旧灯（old lamp）。
questions.evidence: A: Mei brings her old lamp.

questions.prompt: Why does the light not work?
questions.explanation: Tom解释说因为开关松了（loose），所以灯不亮。
questions.evidence: "Because the switch is loose, the light does not work," he explains.

questions.prompt: What does Lisa tell Sam to use? (one word)
questions.explanation: Lisa建议Sam使用结实的针（strong needle），填空只填needle。
questions.evidence: "You should use a strong needle," she says.

questions.prompt: What is the problem with Mr. Chen's radio?
questions.explanation: 志愿者打开收音机后说问题是灰尘（dust）。

questions.prompt: How many items did the volunteers repair?
questions.explanation: 文章最后一段说他们修了十二件东西（twelve things）。

questions.prompt: What does Mei say they should do?
questions.explanation: Mei说“We should tell our neighbours.”，即应该告诉邻居。

options: On the first Saturday of next month
On the first Sunday of next month

grammar.title: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句表示“如果……就……”，结构是：If + 一般现在时，主语 + will + 动词原形。例如：If we repair things, we will produce less waste. because 表示原因，therefore 表示结果。情态动词 should / could / must 用来提建议或说必须做的事：should 表示“应该”，could 表示“可以（建议）”，must 表示“必须”。
grammar.example: "If you show me how to fix it, I will try at home."

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

questions.prompt: ___ she studies hard, she will pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 表示“如果”用 If，引导条件从句。
questions.evidence: If she studies hard, she will pass the exam.

questions.prompt: The road is wet. ___, we should drive slowly.
questions.explanation: 前句是原因，后句是结果，用 Therefore 表示“因此”。
questions.evidence: The road is wet. Therefore, we should drive slowly.

questions.prompt: He is tired ___ he worked all day.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因从句，表示“因为”。
questions.evidence: He is tired because he worked all day.

questions.prompt: You ___ drink more water. It is good for you.
If you finish your homework, you ___ watch TV.
questions.explanation: 这里表示“可以”看电视，用 can 表示允许。
questions.evidence: If you finish your homework, you can watch TV.

questions.prompt: We ___ recycle paper and plastic. It is important.
questions.explanation: must 表示“必须”，语气最强。
questions.evidence: We must recycle paper and plastic.

questions.prompt: If I see him, I ___ him the news.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句主句用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If I see him, I will tell him the news.
